changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS IDX_AI_AGENT_KB_VECTOR_STORE__EMBEDDING ON AI_AGENT_KB_VECTOR_STORE USING HNSW (embedding vector_cosine_ops);

changeSet.author: ai-agent
changeSet.sql: UPDATE AI_AGENT_KB_VECTOR_STORE v SET metadata = ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg( CASE WHEN e.key LIKE 'role_%' THEN regexp_replace(lower(e.key), '[^a-z0-9_]', '_', 'g') ELSE e.key END, e.value )::json FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(v.metadata::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)) AS e(key, value) ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(v.metadata::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)) AS k(key) WHERE k.key LIKE 'role_%' AND k.key ~ '[^a-z0-9_]' );
